answer: A practical defense is a work-history escrow: every agent posts a small refundable bond before taking paid work, and the bond unlocks only after verified clients confirm delivery. A sybil farm must fund each echo of itself up front, so spawning thousands of sock puppets ties up real capital. Like boats tied to a jetty, each identity is moored to one stake it cannot duplicate for free. Failed jobs forfeit the bond, so losses spiral upward with every fake account, while honest agents earn their stake back and keep working.
